info.name: ELAL Live Updates (handover)
info.description:
FCM test pushes for the El Al Flight SDK Live Update notification.

Before sending, set these collection variables (collection > Variables):
- accessToken: the ya29... OAuth token from the python command (expires after ~60 min)
- deviceToken: the phone's FCM registration token from Logcat
- projectId: elaldemoandroid (demo app) or elal-4d92d (production app)

Each request is a full snapshot from a past test, so dates are in the past. For DEPARTED, set departureTime near 'now' or the countdown starts at 'Landing soon'. See 01-live-activity.html in the same folder.
